messages.en: Ooh~
Cute Y/n.
Oh.
I'm still exploring all the new features too.
Huh? Looks like we still can't send videos yet.
I came here because I wanted to send you one.
I'm in the car right now.
I'm on my way somewhere.
After going to the One Asia Festival,
I took a walk along Busan Beach.
It was so healing.
We also had sashimi.
Soomin said she'd never tried sashimi before.
So I wrapped one for her and fed her.

messages.ko: 초장이랑 쌈장 조금씩 넣어 먹으면 맛있단말이야 쌈에는
messages.en: Because if you add a little cho-gochujang and ssamjang to a wrap, it tastes really good.
I can already imagine it.
If you ask me...
She'd probably say, "Why are you eating it like that~"
Then secretly copy the way I eat later.
But Busan seriously...
feels like such a nice place to live.
Especially for me,
there's so much seafood.
And delivery is super fast too.
People from Busan are experts at doing everything quickly.
Wow, that sounds so nice.

messages.ko: 그럼 다현이랑 결혼해야 돼? 그러면 부산 사람이 될 수 있잖아
messages.en: Then should you marry Dahyun? That way you could become a Busan local.
Should I just get married then?
ㅋㅋㅎㅎㅋㄹㅅㅋㄹㄹ
I'll get going now.
I'll come again later.
Haranghae~~
